Hi Samir — thanks for the questionnaire, I reviewed the responses and added notes inline (attached). Short answers to your three bullets below: 

1) Data residency: Redwood supports region-specific routing for customer workloads in our Hosted offering and Dedicated pools (we can pin EU-region capacity). For Hosted API customers requiring EU-only processing we offer a EU-hosted deployment option — well include the data processing Addendum (DPA) and a short description of where processing occurs in the Trust Portal artifact. For PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment with customer-managed networking to meet stricter residency/segmentation needs.

2) Bridge letter / interim attestation: We can provide an interim attestation covering control design and operating effectiveness as of 12/31/2027 and a short bridge letter signed by our Head of Security. Drafts are attached (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_DRAFT_2027.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Interim_Attestation_2027.pdf). The final bridge letter will be issued once the SOC 2 report is finalized and approved by the auditor.

3) Timeline: Our auditors expected publication window for the 2027 SOC 2 Type II report is mid-February to early March 2028. We will provision the Trust Portal this week for PulsePath (secure link below) and upload interim artifacts immediately.

Trust Portal: https://trust.redwood-inference.com/requests/PP-4987 (you will receive a provisioning email; please confirm the admin account to add)

A few items we still need from PulsePath: signed NDA (if required), confirmation of admin user for the portal, and any scope constraints for EU data that would require a Dedicated/Private deployment.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk the draft bridge letter.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Samir — quick technical notes:

- KMS: We support both customer-managed keys (BYOK via AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and Redwood-managed keys. For PHI we recommend BYOK + dedicated capacity.
- Networking: VPC peering and Private deployment are options; there is a short self-serve checklist in the Trust Portal once provisioned.
- Logs & audit: Access logs and audit trails for requests can be exported to a customer S3/Cloud Storage bucket.

If youd like, I can schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive next week to go over KMS flows and network topology.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
